lead_raw_text:
The structure of CuHgAsP3 adopts the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 32 atoms—Cu4Hg4As4P12—and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies tetrahedral Cu centers with four P neighbors (2.25–2.30 Å), while Hg centers show five geometric neighbors (2 P and 3 As, 3.06–3.35 Å). The neighbor graph is three-dimensional, spanning a single 32-site component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and between Cu tetrahedra and As five-vertex polyhedra, as well as corner- and edge-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and Hg five-vertex polyhedra.
